text:
elaine: Quick design review — updated the Private setup wizard Networking step. Two things I want quick eyeballs on: (1) the preflight diagnostics drawer copy (the 'we can't run checks' state), and (2) accessibility when the 'Advanced routing' accordion expands. Screenshot in drive: https://goo.gl/example

miles: Looks good overall. Copy nits: change "we can't run checks" → "Network tests require the Redwood agent to be reachable." Add a short inline help link "Why agent?" that opens KB.

raj: FYI technical constraints: from the hosted probe we can't hit arbitrary on-prem ports (firewall reasons). Please avoid wording that implies we can. Suggest: "Agent must be reachable from your network." Also add a manual check snippet:
```
# from a machine inside the network
curl -v http://AGENT_IP:8080/health
```

ana: Accessibility: when a preflight error is shown, move focus to the first failing field and announce a concise message via aria-live="assertive". Ensure the stepper does not lose keyboard focus when the drawer expands (focus trap + visible focus styles).

elaine: Draft for the blocked state: "Automatic checks require a running agent. If the agent is unavailable, continue with the manual checklist below." Thoughts?

miles: Shorter: "Automatic checks require a running agent. If unavailable, continue with the manual checklist." Remove passive phrasing.

raj: +1. Also add privacy reassurance: "We do not persist agent credentials in Redwood." And maybe: "Network tests do not send your service traffic off-site." Keep it explicit.

ana: Tone: prefer "your service traffic" instead of "customer data." Also add link to privacy page and recommend screenreader example of the announced text.

deployment-bot: deploy succeeded for branch feature/wizard-net-copy (build #4823) :tada:

elaine: Thanks all — I'll update the copy and open a follow-up ticket for the focus trap and live-region tests. Will attach a Figma prototype for keyboard testing. Ping me to pair on the a11y checks.
